This wasn't the "easiest" thing to accomplish in the world, but it really made a difference in some of the things I do.

First, The Reason Why

I have a podcast with a friend, and we have notes, but we also flip through websites and other materials during the cast. I need my notes always on top, no matter what. I also like to watch some podcasts, such as Joe Rogan Experience on UStream while doing other things. The trick to make a window "always on top" is really helpful for things like this, especially if you only use one large monitor as opposed to 2.

Now, The How

This website explains it, but it was actually a little confusing to me at first: http://www.howtogeek.com/196958/the-3-best-ways-to-make-a-window-always-on-top-on-windows/

To Dumb it Down (AKA, How, the dumbed down version),

You install the program called AutoHotKey at AutoHotKey.com (It's lightweight, so it doesn't bog down your computer. At least for me, I noticed NO difference)

Then I went to windows notepad and put this text into it: ^SPACE:: Winset, Alwaysontop, , A

Then I saved the file as AutoHotkey.AHK (The name doesn't really matter, just make sure it ends it .ahk, not .txt, or something else!)

After saving it, go to the file in windows explorer and run the file. It'll automatically run the autohotkey program, and put the icon in your system tray. You won't see anything happen, just go look at your tray. It should be in there.

!!!! You're Done! Pat yourself on the back!! !!!!

Now all you do is hit CTRL and Space at the same time, and whichever window you have open at the time, becomes the window that's always on top.

To stop it, do the same thing: CTRL and Space.

Now enjoy Voat.co while you run a little movie in the corner!
How to make a window (in Microsoft Windows) ALWAYS on top. (Good for movies, or ustreams, notes etc, etc)
